steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Consumer Rights Act 2015 is the main law protecting consumers in contracts with businesses | Key Fact: Goods must be of satisfactory quality, fit for purpose and as described — if not, the consumer has rights to reject, repair or replacement | Key Fact: For faulty goods, the consumer has 30 days to reject for a full refund; after 30 days, they can request repair or replacement | Key Fact: If a repair or replacement fails, the consumer is entitled to a refund (which may be reduced for use)
